articles.title: UP Municipal Employee Accused of Drunken Misconduct, Obscene Gestures Towards Female Staff
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A municipal employee in Uttar Pradesh's Badaun has been accused of reporting to work in an intoxicated state and allegedly making obscene gestures towards female staff members.

body.html:
A municipal employee in Uttar Pradesh's Badaun has been accused of reporting to work in an intoxicated state and allegedly making obscene gestures towards female staff members. A video of the incident has surfaced on social media, prompting a formal complaint and an official response from the police.

The accused has been identified as Vipin Kumar, an employee of the Badaun Nagar Palika (municipal body).

According to reports, the viral video allegedly shows Vipin Kumar under the influence of alcohol inside the government office during duty hours. He is also accused of misbehaving with visitors and making inappropriate remarks and gestures towards female staff members.

Ward Councillor Mohammad Umar recorded the alleged incident and submitted a written complaint along with the video to the District Magistrate (DM), seeking strict disciplinary action against the employee.

The footage has sparked widespread criticism online, with several social media users demanding action over the alleged misconduct inside a government office.

In a statement, Budaun Police said a written complaint has been received at Sahaswan Police Station and that legal proceedings will be initiated based on the complaint.

Authorities are expected to conduct a departmental inquiry into the allegations. Further action will depend on the outcome of the investigation.

#Badaun #UttarPradesh #GovernmentEmployee #MunicipalCorporation

articles.title: Bengaluru Road Rage: Senior Citizen Allegedly Assaulted by Auto Driver After Traffic Dispute
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A senior citizen was allegedly assaulted by an auto-rickshaw driver following a dispute over a traffic violation in Bengaluru.

body.html:
A senior citizen was allegedly assaulted by an auto-rickshaw driver following a dispute over a traffic violation in Bengaluru. The incident, which reportedly took place on July 16 under the HAL Police Station limits, was captured on a car's dashcam and has since gone viral on social media.

According to preliminary information, the altercation began after the auto-rickshaw driver allegedly entered a one-way road from the wrong direction and stopped his vehicle, obstructing traffic.

Police said the elderly motorcyclist questioned the driver over the alleged traffic violation, leading to a verbal argument that quickly escalated into a physical confrontation.

Dashcam footage circulating online appears to show the auto-rickshaw driver allegedly assaulting the senior citizen in the middle of the road.

The video has sparked widespread concern on social media, with many calling for strict action and highlighting the growing number of road rage incidents in Bengaluru.

HAL Police have taken cognisance of the incident and initiated an inquiry. Officers are examining the dashcam footage and recording statements from those involved and any available witnesses to establish the sequence of events.

Police said further legal action will be taken based on the findings of the investigation. Authorities have also urged motorists to avoid confrontations on the road and report such incidents to the police.

#Bengaluru #Karnataka #RoadRage #Dashcam #TrafficViolation

articles.title: Viral CCTV Video of Delivery Worker Entering Home Sparks Online Safety Debate
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A CCTV video purportedly showing a delivery worker attempting to enter a customer's home has gone viral on social media, triggering widespread debate over customer safety and privacy during doorstep deliveries.

body.html:
A CCTV video purportedly showing a delivery worker attempting to enter a customer's home has gone viral on social media, triggering widespread debate over customer safety and privacy during doorstep deliveries.

According to claims circulating online, the delivery worker arrived to deliver an order and allegedly tried to enter the house after the door was opened by a young woman. The footage appears to show family members immediately intervening, raising an alarm and asking the delivery worker to step back and leave the premises.

The incident has sparked concerns among social media users about the safety of customers, particularly women, during home deliveries. Many have called for stricter safety protocols and better training for delivery personnel.

However, the authenticity of the claims associated with the viral video has not been independently verified. It also remains unclear whether the delivery worker intentionally attempted to enter the house or whether the incident has been misinterpreted.

No official statement has been issued by the delivery platform regarding the viral video so far.

Authorities have also not confirmed the circumstances surrounding the incident. Further details are awaited.

#ViralVideo #CCTV #HomeDelivery #CustomerSafety

articles.title: Hyderabad Water Board Cracks Down on Drinking Water Misuse, ₹5,000 Fine Imposed
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: The Hyderabad Water Board has warned residents against wasting drinking water after officials detected its misuse while washing the premises of a building on Jubilee Hills Road No. 33.

body.html:
The Hyderabad Water Board has warned residents against wasting drinking water after officials detected its misuse while washing the premises of a building on Jubilee Hills Road No. 33.

Following an inspection, the Water Board's O&M Division-6 issued a ₹5,000 fine, directing the consumer to pay the amount within seven days.

Officials said drinking water must be used responsibly under the provisions of the Water Board Act, 1989, and warned that repeated violations could result in the disconnection of water and sewerage connections, along with further legal action.

The Board has urged citizens not to use drinking water for washing vehicles, roads or building premises and to conserve water responsibly.

#Hyderabad #WaterBoard #WaterConservation #Telangana

articles.title: Youth Allegedly Assaulted for Walking With Muslim Woman, Moral Policing Case Registered
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A case of alleged moral policing has come to light from Karnataka's Bengaluru Rural district, where a Hindu youth was allegedly assaulted by a group of men for walking with a Muslim woman in Dabaspet, Nelamangala taluk.

body.html:
A case of alleged moral policing has come to light from Karnataka's Bengaluru Rural district, where a Hindu youth was allegedly assaulted by a group of men for walking with a Muslim woman in Dabaspet, Nelamangala taluk.

The incident reportedly took place in Lakkur village under the jurisdiction of Dabaspet police station.

According to the complaint, the victim, Yashwant, was walking with a Muslim woman, identified as Kausar Banu, when they were allegedly stopped by three men identified as Sohel Pasha, Syed Karim and Tehreek Pasha.

The accused allegedly abused Yashwant, questioned him and physically assaulted him.

The incident was reportedly recorded on a mobile phone, and the video was later circulated on WhatsApp groups.

According to reports, Kausar Banu was deeply distressed after the video went viral. She has since filed a complaint at the Dabaspet police station against the alleged attackers.

Police have registered a case and initiated an investigation into the incident. Further action will be taken based on the findings of the probe.

#Karnataka #BengaluruRural #Dabaspet #MoralPolicing #CrimeNews

articles.title: West Bengal: Wife, Alleged Lover Among Five Arrested for Beheading Husband Over Extramarital Affair
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Bagdogra police in West Bengal have claimed to have solved the murder of a man whose headless body was found in a tea garden, arresting five people, including the victim's wife and her alleged lover, within 48 hours.

body.html:
Bagdogra police in West Bengal have claimed to have solved the murder of a man whose headless body was found in a tea garden, arresting five people, including the victim's wife and her alleged lover, within 48 hours.

The deceased has been identified as Imam, a resident of Kishanganj district in Bihar, who worked as a traditional faith healer (ojha).

According to police, the accused include Imam's wife, Tumpa Ghosh alias Momina Begum; her alleged lover, Sudip Pal of Chandal Jote in Goshaipur, Bagdogra; Sudip's nephews, Bapi Pal and Nitai Pal of Jalpaiguri; and their associate, Kaushik Nath.

The case came to light on Tuesday after a headless body was recovered from the No. 9 Section of Haskhowa Tea Garden under the Bagdogra police station limits. Police identified the victim through an identity card recovered from the body, following which his family confirmed his identity at North Bengal Medical College and Hospital.

Police said both Imam and Momina worked as traditional faith healers. Investigators alleged that Momina had been in a long-standing extramarital relationship with Sudip, who is married and has two sons.

According to the investigation, the accused allegedly conspired to eliminate Imam so the couple could live together. Police alleged that Imam was lured to Haskhowa, where he was attacked, his throat was slit, he was beheaded, and his body was dumped in the tea garden.

Following the investigation, police arrested all five accused and produced them before the Siliguri Sub-Divisional Court, which remanded them to police custody for further investigation.

Police said they have recovered the weapon allegedly used in the murder as well as the victim's severed head. Investigators are continuing to reconstruct the sequence of events and determine the role of each accused.

#WestBengal #Bagdogra #CrimeNews #MurderCase #BreakingNews

articles.title: Wife, Alleged Lover Accused of Using Venomous Snake to Kill School Operator
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Police have claimed to have solved the mysterious death of a private school operator in Uttar Pradesh's Meerut, alleging that his wife conspired with her alleged lover and two snake charmers to murder him by staging a fatal snakebite.

body.html:
Police have claimed to have solved the mysterious death of a private school operator in Uttar Pradesh's Meerut, alleging that his wife conspired with her alleged lover and two snake charmers to murder him by staging a fatal snakebite.

The victim, Atul Kumar Panwar (32), was found dead at his rented house in J-Block Colony under the Hastinapur police station area on Friday morning. Initially believed to be an accidental snakebite death, investigators now allege it was a premeditated murder.

According to police, Atul was first given milk allegedly laced with an overdose of sleeping pills. While he was unconscious, a highly venomous krait snake was allegedly released into his blanket, resulting in fatal snakebites.

Police have arrested Atul's wife, Damini, her alleged lover Tushar, who worked as a bus driver at the couple's school, and two snake charmers, Sonu and Uday, for their alleged roles in the conspiracy.

Investigators said the victim's family had raised suspicions immediately after his death, prompting police to examine Damini's call records. Frequent contact with Tushar allegedly led investigators to question him, during which he reportedly confessed to the conspiracy.

During questioning, Damini told police that she had moved to another room with their six-year-old son around 2 am. She claimed she returned in the morning to find her husband unresponsive under a blanket and noticed a snake after removing it.

Police later found snakebite marks on Atul's body. The body was sent for post-mortem examination, while forensic teams examined the scene.

Atul and Damini had a love marriage and were running Krishna Kids Play School in Hastinapur, which catered to around 150 students. Police said Tushar had joined the school as a bus driver a few months ago.

Senior Superintendent of Police (SSP) Avinash Pandey said the investigation indicated that the death was the result of a planned murder rather than an accidental snakebite.

Police said further investigation is underway to establish the complete sequence of events and gather additional evidence.

#Meerut #UttarPradesh #CrimeNews #MurderMystery

articles.title: Varanasi Cop Suspended After Video Shows Woman Complainant Allegedly Slapped Repeatedly
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A woman police inspector in Uttar Pradesh's Varanasi has been suspended after a video allegedly showing her slapping a woman complainant multiple times inside a police station surfaced on social media, triggering widespread criticism.

body.html:
A woman police inspector in Uttar Pradesh's Varanasi has been suspended after a video allegedly showing her slapping a woman complainant multiple times inside a police station surfaced on social media, triggering widespread criticism.

The incident took place at the Chaubepur police station on Thursday evening. The suspended officer has been identified as Sub-Inspector Roshni Singh, a 2023-batch officer currently posted at the police station.

According to police, the complainant, Geeta Devi, a Dalit woman from Paranapur village, had approached the police regarding an alleged land encroachment dispute. She had earlier filed a complaint alleging that some people were encroaching on land allotted to her under a government lease.

On July 16, both parties were called to the police station for questioning. According to the complainant, the officer asked her to call her husband. Geeta allegedly replied that her husband had gone to work and that the family depended on daily wages.

A video of the incident, which surfaced on Friday, allegedly shows the officer slapping Geeta Devi several times within a few seconds inside the police station. The complainant further alleged that she was later taken into a room and assaulted again.

Following the video's circulation, Deputy Commissioner of Police (DCP) Pramod Kumar suspended Inspector Roshni Singh and ordered a departmental inquiry.

ACP Sarnath Vinay Dwivedi said the police had taken cognisance of the viral video and that further action would be taken based on the findings of the investigation.

The incident has sparked criticism on social media, with users questioning police conduct and the treatment of complainants inside police stations.

#Varanasi #UttarPradesh #Police #PoliceMisconduct #ViralVideo

articles.title: Drunk Youth Allegedly Occupies Inspector's Chair, Vandalises Empty Hapur Police Outpost
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A young man allegedly created chaos at the Doyami police outpost in Uttar Pradesh's Hapur late on Friday night after arriving in an intoxicated state.

body.html:
A young man allegedly created chaos at the Doyami police outpost in Uttar Pradesh's Hapur late on Friday night after arriving in an intoxicated state. He allegedly claimed to be a police inspector, occupied the inspector's chair, tampered with official files and vandalised the premises before being detained by police.

According to preliminary information, the youth allegedly entered the outpost after becoming upset that police had not listened to his complaint. Claiming to be an inspector, he sat at the officer's desk, signed several official files, tore up some documents and declared that he would decide cases "on the spot."

He then allegedly vandalised the police outpost, damaging flower pots, the main gate, glass panels, benches and other property.

Eyewitnesses claimed that no police personnel, including the outpost in-charge, were present for nearly 30 minutes while the incident unfolded. Local residents gathered after hearing the commotion but reportedly did not intervene due to the youth's aggressive behaviour.

Police later reached the spot, overpowered the accused after considerable effort and took him into custody. During the vandalism, the youth reportedly sustained injuries to his arms and legs from broken glass and was taken to a hospital for treatment.

Preliminary investigation indicates that the accused was under the influence of alcohol. Police said legal action is being initiated against him under relevant provisions, including those related to damaging public property.

The incident has also raised questions over the absence of police personnel at the outpost during the disturbance. Eyewitnesses alleged that the outpost remained unattended for nearly half an hour, prompting concerns about emergency response and public safety.

Police are investigating both the vandalism and the circumstances that led to the outpost being unattended at the time of the incident.

#Hapur #UttarPradesh #Police #ViralVideo #CrimeNews

articles.title: Newlywed Man Found Murdered Hours After Reception in Ballari
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A 27-year-old newlywed man was found murdered in Karnataka's Ballari city just hours after his wedding reception, with police investigating whether his recent love marriage to a divorced woman played a role in the crime.

body.html:
A 27-year-old newlywed man was found murdered in Karnataka's Ballari city just hours after his wedding reception, with police investigating whether his recent love marriage to a divorced woman played a role in the crime.

The deceased, identified as Nabi Rasul, was a resident of Samata Nagar in the Bhatti area of Ballari. He worked at the Boti Market and also took up masonry work.

According to police, Rasul had recently married a divorced woman after the couple allegedly eloped about 15 days ago. While the woman's family had reportedly opposed the relationship, Rasul's family accepted the marriage and organised a wedding reception on Thursday.

Police said Rasul left his house at around 11.30 pm after telling his family that he had received a call from a friend. When he failed to return, his family began searching for him.

At around 2 am, his body was found in a pool of blood about 700 metres from his residence. Police have confirmed that he was murdered, though the exact cause of death is yet to be established.

Ballari Superintendent of Police Suman D. Pennekar, along with other senior officers and forensic experts, visited the crime scene, conducted an inspection and collected evidence.

A murder case has been registered at Kaul Bazaar Police Station, and special teams have been formed to identify and arrest those responsible.

Investigators are questioning family members, friends and local residents, while also examining the victim's recent movements, mobile phone records and other evidence to reconstruct the sequence of events.

Police said all possible angles are being investigated, including the couple's recent love marriage, alleged opposition from the woman's family, personal enmity and other possible motives. Officials said further details will emerge as the investigation progresses.

#Karnataka #Ballari #MurderCase #CrimeNews #LoveMarriage
